messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Holly Barnes <h.barnes@acmeinc.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: MAP milestones & legal redline ownership / proposed TATs

Hi Holly / Marco —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation. Per our agreement on the call, I wanted to send a short, actionable MAP excerpt focused on the legal milestones so we’re explicit about who owns what and expected turnaround times. Please see the proposed items below and flag anything you want changed.

Proposed MAP legal milestones (short):
- MSA initial redlines received (owner: Acme Legal) — target: 2027-05-18
- Redwood initial review + response w/ counter-redlines (owner: Redwood Legal) — target: 2 business days after receiving redlines
- Technical SSO & data flow addendum review (owner: Redwood Engineering / Dev) — target: 3 business days after counter-redlines
- DPA & security appendix alignment (owner: joint — Acme Legal to propose changes; Redwood to confirm) — target: aligned with MSA cadence
- SLA confirmation & reporting schedule (owner: Redwood Product + Acme Procurement) — target: during legal exchange

Suggested rules for redline exchanges:
- Single-source doc: please send redlines on the MSA Word doc (we’ll keep a running change log).
- Turnaround expectations: Redwood legal will aim to issue a first response within 2 business days of receipt. If we need internal engineering input (SSO, retention), we’ll mark those sections and aim for a max of 3 business days.
- Escalation: If either party needs an exception to standard terms, please mark the clause and identify a single point of contact for the approval path.

Attachments: I’ve attached a MAP snapshot (Acme-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx) and a baseline MSA we’d like you to redline (MSA-Proposed-Redlines.docx).

Next steps from Redwood side:
- Marissa: will create a shared MAP tracker and update milestones.
- Karthik: will be the Redwood legal reviewer for first pass.
- Dev: will be the engineering contact for SSO/technical items.

Holly — what is your internal legal cadence? Are there blackout dates next week we should avoid?

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0123
--

- Acme Legal can turn around an initial redline within 3 business days (they are heads-down next week on a procurement wave, so earliest we can get to it is Thu 5/16).
- Marco (procurement) will coordinate internal SLA expectations — he’s copied here.
- Our legal lead for this effort is Evan Park (evan.park@acmelegal.com). Evan, looping you in — can you confirm 5/16 for the first pass?

One ask: can Redwood confirm the 2 business day target for your initial response? If there are technical items that will push beyond that, we’d like to see those flagged quickly so we can prioritize.

Hi Holly / Marco / Evan (if you’re on-thread) —

Confirmed on Redwood side: we will provide an initial legal response within 2 business days of receiving Acme’s redlines. If we encounter sections that require engineering input (SSO, retention, export controls), we will flag them in the response and provide a target ETA — our standard for those is 3 business days but we’ll escalate any priority items.

A couple of notes so expectations are explicit:
1) Please send redlines as tracked changes on the Word MSA (we’ll keep one master).
2) If Acme needs deviations from our standard DPA or SLA, please call those out in the redline with a suggested replacement clause so we can route approvals faster.
3) If the negotiation requires exec approval (discounts, indemnity shifts, bespoke SLAs), please include the approver’s name in the comment thread.

Dev — can you stand by for any technical clarifications? If Acme sends SAML metadata or retention schedules we should reply within 3 business days.

Holly — looking forward to 5/16 for your first pass. If that slips, please give us a heads-up and we’ll adjust MAP milestones accordingly.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
